title: fix(plugin-form,plugin-list,plugin-view,react): read SchemaRendererContext as declared, not through a cast to any (objectui#7209)
body:
Fixes #7209
Clause-②: no

Every `SchemaRendererContext` type-erasing cast in the claim's four files is gone, so each of those reads sees `SchemaRendererContextType` exactly as `@object-ui/react` declares it. A read of a member the context does not declare (the objectui#7206 `ctx.formValues ?? ctx.data` shape) is now a compile error at each of them. No runtime value changes and no published type moves.

Dispatched by the `domain:ui#1` seat (claim comment 5819439599). Implementing session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`.

⚠️ Angle brackets are spelled out in words below (for example "`React.Context` of `any`"), because GitHub strips tag-shaped fragments from PR bodies, even inside backticks.

## Census at `origin/main` (dispatch Zone 2, step 1)

Base `7616d893`. Widened to every `useContext` of `SchemaRendererContext` under any alias or cast, tests excluded: `git grep -n -E "useContext\(\s*[A-Za-z]*SchemaRendererContext"` over `packages/*/src/*`, `apps/*` and `examples/*`, plus every `SchemaRendererContext as` spelling and every `Context` of `any`. Control: the same pathspec returns 114 `useContext(` lines in 86 files, so the instrument is live.

That census finds six casts, not five:

| site | shape | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| `plugin-form/src/index.tsx`, `EmbeddableFormRenderer` | `useContext(SchemaRendererContext as React.Context` of `any`) | removed |
| `plugin-form/src/index.tsx`, `MasterDetailFormRenderer` | same | removed |
| `plugin-list/src/ListViewBlock.tsx`, `ListViewBlock` | same | removed |
| `plugin-view/src/index.tsx`, module scope | `const SchemaRendererContext: React.Context` of `any` `= ImportedSchemaRendererContext` | removed: the alias is deleted and the import is used directly |
| `react/src/element-data-source/ElementDataSourceGate.tsx`, `useResolvedDataSource` | `React.useContext(SchemaRendererContext as React.Context` of `any`) | removed |
| `react/src/hooks/useElementDataSource.ts`, `useElementDataSource` | `useContext(SchemaRendererContext as Context` of `any`), spelled with the bare imported `Context` | removed in round 2 (`a879ffe6`), together with the now-unused `Context` type import |

The card's other two sites are already gone at base. `LookupField` was repaired by `edea22a5`, and `useCascadingOptions.ts` has 0 hits.

## What dropping each cast surfaced (step 2)

`tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` per package, with every cast dropped and nothing else changed:

- `@object-ui/react`: exit 0.
- `@object-ui/plugin-list`: exit 0.
- `@object-ui/plugin-form`, exit 2. `src/index.tsx` TS2322: "Type 'DataSource of any | null | undefined' is not assignable to type 'DataSource of any | undefined'." This is the `EmbeddableForm dataSource={ctx?.dataSource}` handoff.
- `@object-ui/plugin-view`, exit 2. `src/index.tsx` TS2322: "Type 'DataSource of any | null' is not assignable to type 'DataSource of any'." This is the `ObjectView dataSource` handoff.

⭐ **The Zone 2 assumption that "each error is a read of a member the context does not declare" is falsified at every site: 0 of 2.** Both errors come from the DECLARED member `dataSource: DataSource | null | undefined` handing its `null` ("no adapter bound") to a prop that does not admit `null`. No undeclared-member read was hiding behind any of the five casts, because objectui#7206's retirement already removed the only one. So no provider search was needed, and there is no dead channel to remove or re-derive.

The fix at each surfaced error:

- **`EmbeddableFormRenderer`**: the `null` collapses to `undefined` (`ctx?.dataSource ?? undefined`), exactly as `MasterDetailFormRenderer` in the same file already did. The runtime result is identical. `EmbeddableForm` only ever tests the adapter for truthiness. `ElementDataSourceGate` resolves its explicit value first and then the context through `??`, so a `null` and an `undefined` explicit value are the same input.
- **`ObjectViewRenderer`**: `ObjectViewProps.dataSource` is declared REQUIRED `DataSource`, and objectui#7842 ruled that widening it is a maintainer's call. That file is also fenced (open objectui#10283). The renderer passes `null` when no provider is mounted, and `ObjectView`'s prop doc names this renderer as that `null` caller. Neither removal nor re-derivation is possible without that contract change, so under step 2's third branch a cast stays on this site. **It is narrowed from the whole context to the one value**: `(ctx?.dataSource ?? null) as DataSource`, with a comment. The context read itself now uses the declared type and is pinned. The passed value is byte-for-byte what it was. This is a judgement call, and it is raised for the seat in the report's `open_questions`.
- **Seat ruling, round 2 (Q2 = A):** the narrowed value assertion stays. It crosses exactly one declared-null value into objectui#7842's required prop, and it carries a comment naming objectui#7842.

## `useResolvedDataSource`'s declaration is byte-identical (step 3)

- Base leg: `ElementDataSourceGate.tsx` was put back to its base bytes (confirmed with `git diff --quiet 7616d893 -- FILE`, and the blob `2db3dd44` is base's). Declarations were then emitted fresh with `tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --incremental false` into a scratch directory.
- Head leg: the same emission at head.
- Result: `element-data-source/ElementDataSourceGate.d.ts` has sha256 `73212725…4805305d` on both legs, and `cmp` exits 0. The whole 67-file `packages/react` declaration tree compares equal under `diff -r` (exit 0). The file was restored with proof: blob `212f6039` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Step 4: nothing user-visible

No dead read surfaced, so there is no behaviour to pin. The runtime values handed down are unchanged at all five sites.

## Pins: one type-level leg per site

There are five files, one beside each touched source file:

- `plugin-form/src/__tests__/schemaRendererContextRead-7209.test.ts` (2 sites);
- `plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListViewBlock.schemaRendererContextRead-7209.test.ts`;
- `plugin-view/src/__tests__/objectViewRenderer.schemaRendererContextRead-7209.test.ts`;
- `react/src/element-data-source/__tests__/useResolvedDataSource.schemaRendererContextRead-7209.test.ts`;
- `react/src/hooks/__tests__/useElementDataSource.schemaRendererContextRead-7209.test.ts` (round 2).

**Why a `ts.Program` leg rather than the `@ts-expect-error` the dispatch gave as an example.** Each context value lives in a local inside its renderer. Nothing a test can import carries that value's type, so a directive in a test file stays satisfied when the cast is restored at the site. `getTypeAtLocation` on the hook call itself is the instrument that sees the cast. This follows the shape `record-details.hideFieldsUncast-9965.test.ts` established. No per-site pin followed the `LookupField` repair in `edea22a5`: that commit pinned the context type itself (`SchemaRendererContext.dataSourceType.pin.test.ts`), not the read sites.

For each site, the pin checks:

- **The read carries the declared type.** The hook call's type equals the declared value type, which is derived from `@object-ui/react`'s own `SchemaRendererContext` export in the same program and never written down. It must not be `any`.
- **PROBE.** `formValues`, the member objectui#7206 retired, is not readable off the value: no property, no index signature, not `any`.
- **LIT CONTROL.** `dataSource` reads at its declared type.
- **CALIBRATION.** The same call with a cast planted back IN MEMORY reads `any`, so every verdict above is one this instrument can reach.
- **Locator.** The site is located by its declaration NAME and must hold exactly one such read. Zero or two reads throw instead of passing.

The program resolves `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/core` to source, because test shards build nothing. It is built at module scope (import phase, not bounded by a test timeout), with parsed files shared between the real and the planted program. Run alone, one file imports in about 5 s. 29 tests across the five files, all green.

## Ablation, with on-disk proof (committed first; `ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode, restore by trap)

**A: the card's shape.** The `EmbeddableFormRenderer` cast was restored in `plugin-form/src/index.tsx` (anchor 1 to 0, replacement 0 to 1, blob `059806a7` to `f8d4d505`).

- Result: `Tests 3 failed | 6 passed`. Exactly that site's three rows went red. `MasterDetailFormRenderer` and the calibration rows stayed green.
- The failing assertion was `"isAny": false` expected, `true` received, and `"type": "SchemaRendererContextType | null"` expected, `"any"` received.
- Restored: blob `059806a7` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

**B: the alias shape, which the in-memory calibration does not cover.** The module-level alias was restored in `plugin-view/src/index.tsx` (blob `d70dbed3` to `bf3b7660`).

- Result: `Tests 3 failed | 2 passed`, with the same three rows red.
- Restored: blob `d70dbed3` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

The observed red is a failing test assertion, not an unused `@ts-expect-error`, because the pin is a program leg. The harness reads source directly, so no build or `dist/` sits between the mutation and the verdict.

## Verification

On `e44132f6` (the implementation commit):

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-form/ packages/plugin-list/ apps/console/src/__tests__/public-block-binding-reach.test.tsx`: `Test Files 200 passed (200)`, `Tests 2159 passed | 1 skipped`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-view/`: 45 files, 409 passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/react/`: 93 files, 1173 passed.
- Narrowed lint, since the repo-wide scan belongs to CI:
  - Population: the 8 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files. `eslint --format json` reports all 8 as linted, none ignored: 0 errors. Every warning belongs to a pre-existing class in the touched files (`react-refresh/only-export-components`, `no-explicit-any`).
  - Invariance: `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), and no local rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem. So this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

On `49a5e86d` (the head, after merging `origin/main` `31938f01`; the merge touched none of this PR's files):

- `turbo run build` of the dependency closure: 15/15.
- `type-check` (both tsconfigs) exits 0 for `@object-ui/react`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-view`, `plugin-detail` and `plugin-grid`. The last two import `useResolvedDataSource`. `--listFilesOnly` confirms each touched package's test tsconfig compiles its new pin.
- The 4 pins plus 4 neighbours (`public-block-binding-reach`, `ObjectView.dataSourceContextFallback-7842`, `EmbeddableForm`, `ElementDataSourceGate`): 8 files, 120 passed.
- These gates all exit 0: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check-changeset-presence`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:self-import`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `check-lint-coverage`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 9 paths reports NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED on `49a5e86d`: the full package suites above were not re-run after the merge, because they ran on `e44132f6` and the merge touched none of this PR's files. CI runs them on this head.

## Round 2 (`a879ffe6`, on `origin/main` `1f8ef0a8`)

The seat widened the claim surface to the sixth site (Q1 = A).

- **Change:** the sixth cast and its now-unused `Context` type import are gone.
- **Measured on disk:** the hook call's type moves from `any` to `SchemaRendererContextType | null`, with 0 diagnostics in the `packages/react` program.
- **Type-check:** `type-check` (both tsconfigs) exits 0 for `@object-ui/react` and for `@object-ui/components`, its only importer outside react.
- **Pin:** `react/src/hooks/__tests__/useElementDataSource.schemaRendererContextRead-7209.test.ts`, 5 rows.
- **Ablation:** restoring the cast and the `Context` import on disk gives `Test Files 1 failed | 4 passed (5)` and `Tests 3 failed | 26 passed (29)` across all five pin files; only that site's three rows go red. After restoring, blob `4a01194c` equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Declarations:** the whole 67-file `@object-ui/react` declaration tree is byte-identical between `origin/main` and head (`diff -r` exit 0; `useElementDataSource.d.ts` sha256 `6d4d0b30…54d653a6` on both). Lit control: a planted `dataSource?: string` does show in that diff.
- **Suites:** `packages/react/` suites plus the pins give 97 files, 1197 passed.
- **Changeset:** it now names six sites.

## Changeset

`.changeset/7209-schema-renderer-context-read-as-declared.md` declares `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `@object-ui/plugin-view` and `@object-ui/react`. It is type-only: no runtime value changes anywhere.

## Acceptance notes

- **The sixth site, `react/src/hooks/useElementDataSource.ts`, was fixed in round 2.** See 「Round 2」 above.
- **`check:changeset-claims` asked for one read.** `.changeset/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.md` names `plugin-view/src/index.tsx` as the file that registers the `object-view` renderer. I re-read that paragraph: it is still true, because the registration is unchanged.
- **The pin harness appears once per package.** Each copy stays inside its own package. A single class-wide guard, reading every `useContext` of this context under `packages/*/src` as declared, would also catch sites nobody has written yet. It is not built here: it lies outside the fence, and a new guard is the seat's call.
